summary: Portable fixed-rate timing payloads and loader for Command & Conquer Red Alert 3: Uprising (EP1 1.0).
language: C11 (GNU extensions for the i686 bridges)

build.loader_alias: Uprising60.exe (identical loader bytes, kept for existing dependency documentation)
build.cross_test_note: tests/test_sway_runtime.c is the actual i686 bridge fixture; it builds in every i686 Windows configuration and runs in-place only (success prints 'PASS' and exits 42; CTest gates on the PASS banner).

supported_game.title: Command & Conquer Red Alert 3: Uprising (EP1), version 1.0
supported_game.compatibility_note: The loader refuses any executable whose SHA-256 or PE identity does not match these values, and never writes the game executable.

loader.name: RA3EP1FPSUnlock.exe
loader.behavior: Verifies the game SHA-256, starts the game, then asks the game to LoadLibrary the payload DLL via a remote thread on LoadLibraryW.

env_switches.U60_BASELINE: Non-empty value keeps native 30 FPS timing and logs baseline-only measurements.

rate_model.schedule_120: cycle stage ends {1,2,3,3,4,5,5,6}; stages 3 and 5 re-display (hold); 90 native stage calls per 120 displays
rate_model.schedule_60: native 4:1 batching, cycle ends {2,3,5,6}, first-display threshold 6 -> 8
rate_model.suspension: authored 30 Hz spring; display blend beta = i/N with one step of latency; external per-drawable cache
rate_model.display_ms: rational Bresenham clock, exactly 1000 ms per fps frames
rate_model.gpu_particles: keep authored 30 Hz lifetime units at every rate

evidence_scope.runtime: The i686 bridge fixture passed at -O2 for 60 and 120 (exit 42) in the owning project's Windows-on-Mac runtime harness; 90 FPS remains research-only with an unresolved in-motion landing discontinuity.
evidence_scope.windows_native: Windows-native execution is not asserted by this repository; CI compiles the same sources with MinGW-w64 and runs the host contract tests.

license: MIT (see LICENSE); original source; no game code, Wine code, or SAGE-Unlocked GPL source included.

diagnostics.model_trace: src/model_trace.h ships the bounded diagnostic journal; RA3_MODEL_TRACE defaults to 0 and the stable profile compiles it out entirely.
